questions.question: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the true value of a good education.
options: I didn't realize the value of a good education until after finishing my degree.
I only realized the value of a good education after completing my studies.
It wasn't until I'd completed my degree that I understood the real importance of an education.
The value of a good education became clear to me only once I had finished university.
questions.answer: It was not until I had finished my degree that I realized the true value of a good education.

questions.question: By the time I arrived at the party, most of the guests had already left.
options: The majority of the guests were still there when I arrived.
I found that many people were still chatting and laughing when I got to the party.
Most of the guests had departed before my arrival.
It was only a few minutes after my arrival that most of the guests began to leave.
questions.answer: By the time I arrived at the party, most of the guests had already left.

questions.question: Unless you study hard, you will never succeed in your exams.
options: If you don't work hard, it's unlikely that you'll pass your exams.
Only by studying diligently can you expect to achieve good grades.
You must put in a lot of effort if you want to do well in your exams.
Hard work is essential for achieving academic success.
questions.answer: Unless you study hard, you will never succeed in your exams.

questions.question: It was reported that the new policy would have a significant impact on local businesses.
options: The new policy is expected to affect many small enterprises.
Local companies are likely to be severely impacted by this new regulation.
There's been talk about how much of an effect this policy will have on regional businesses.
This new legislation has the potential to greatly influence local economic conditions.
questions.answer: It was reported that the new policy would have a significant impact on local businesses.

questions.question: What I had been looking forward to all day was finally over.
options: The event I'd been dreading for hours was now behind me.
It was a relief that the stressful situation had come to an end.
I felt a sense of accomplishment once the challenging task was completed.
The long-awaited moment of relaxation had finally arrived.
questions.answer: What I had been looking forward to all day was finally over.
